blocks.text: The loved ones of Jorybelle Agoto, the lead star of the acclaimed film “Filipiñana,” are appealing for financial assistance as the actress remains in critical care while battling cancer. The team behind the movie disclosed Agoto’s condition through its Instagram page on Thursday, Sept. 24. “We are calling for your support to help Jorrybell in her ongoing battle against cancer. She is currently in the Critical Care Unit at St. Luke’s Hospital, where she is relying on a Blake drain to manage fluid in her lungs and help her breathe,” it said. “The mounting medical expenses have become overwhelming, and we […]...
